name: Bethor Iceshard
summary: In the Undercity, Bethor Iceshard directs the Magic Quarter's arcane and shadow practitioners. He holds authority in Sylvanas's realm, though old friendships still mark his past.

sections.title: Master of the Magic Quarter
sections.body: From the Temple of the Damned in the Undercity, Bethor Iceshard directs arcane and shadow practitioners. His keen mind and icy resolve earn respect and fear. His political and magical authority reaches magistrates across Lordaeron. He sends Forsaken agents after valuable grimoires and arcane disturbances, and against rival powers that threaten the Undercity's rule.

sections.title: Old Friends and Bittersweet Reunions
sections.body: Bethor Iceshard searches Tirisfal and Silverpine for powerful undead spellcasters. He sends agents to learn whether rogue practitioners serve the Lich King or might join the Forsaken. At Brightwater Lake, he finds Gunther Arcanus raising the dead and patiently tries to bring his old friend into Lady Sylvanas's fold. Thule Ravenclaw finds no such mercy. His willing betrayal doomed their brotherhood.

sections.title: Bonds of Apprenticehood
sections.body: Before the Third War devastated Lordaeron, Bethor Iceshard studied magic as a mortal apprentice beside Gunther Arcanus and Thule Ravenclaw. The three were close companions, and they wove their practice wands together to mark their fellowship. Then the Scourge swept across the kingdom with death and dark magic. Thule willingly gave his soul to the Lich King. Gunther perished and rose again on an isolated island in Brightwater Lake. Bethor fell too, then broke free as Forsaken.

faq.answer: Bethor Iceshard directs arcane and shadow practitioners at the Temple of the Damned in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. He guides magical research, gathers intelligence on rogue practitioners, and oversees covert arcane operations for the Dark Lady.

faq.q: Where can Bethor Iceshard be found?
faq.answer: Bethor Iceshard resides inside the Temple of the Damned in the Undercity's Magic Quarter.

faq.q: What is Bethor's history with Gunther Arcanus?
faq.answer: Bethor Iceshard and Gunther Arcanus were close friends and fellow apprentice mages in Lordaeron. Both died during the Scourge invasion, then broke free from the Lich King's control. Bethor arranged for Gunther to join the Forsaken.

faq.q: Who was Thule Ravenclaw to Bethor?
faq.answer: Thule Ravenclaw was the third member of Bethor Iceshard and Gunther Arcanus's apprentice circle. During the Scourge invasion, he willingly pledged his soul to the Lich King and became a hated necromancer living at Fenris Isle.

faq.q: What is the story behind Bethor's wand?
faq.answer: As young apprentices, Bethor Iceshard, Gunther Arcanus, and Thule Ravenclaw wove their practice wands together as a sign of eternal friendship. The braided keepsake binds the three fractured spellcasters to their mortal past.

faq.q: What role does Bethor play in Forsaken society?
faq.answer: Bethor Iceshard is one of the Undercity's leading arcane authorities. He guides newly risen magi and warlocks, directs intelligence on rogue necromancers, and holds authority over regional Forsaken officials such as magistrate Sevren.

angles.text: As a Forsaken mage, you can see in Bethor Iceshard how arcane arts endure through undeath.
As an Undead, you may know the pain of losing friends and home to the Scourge, then facing former allies as enemies.
As a member of the Horde, you benefit from Bethor Iceshard's offensive magic and efforts against necromancy, which protect the Horde's foothold across Lordaeron.
